title: Basic individual tax return: what to bring
use_when: Pick this for a simple wage-earner return with no business or rental income, where the short IRS free tax preparation (VITA) list is enough.
note: Built from the IRS checklist for free tax return preparation and the Form 13614-C intake sheet. The IRS also says both spouses must be present to sign a joint return filed electronically. Business, rental and state-specific items are not covered.

vita.name: IRS, Checklist for free tax return preparation (web page, last reviewed or updated 24-Oct-2026)

f13614c.name: IRS, Form 13614-C, Intake/Interview and Quality Review Sheet (Rev. 10-2026)

situations.no-ssn: Someone on the return has an ITIN instead of a Social Security number
situations.itin-applying: Someone on the return is applying for an ITIN
situations.retirement: Took money from a retirement account, pension or annuity
situations.social-security: Received Social Security or Railroad Retirement benefits
situations.other-income: Had other income reported on Form 1099-MISC
situations.direct-deposit: Wants the refund by direct deposit
situations.marketplace-insurance: Bought health insurance through the Marketplace
situations.education: Someone in the family took educational classes

items.label: Original photo ID for you, and for your spouse if filing jointly
items.detail: Examples the IRS lists: valid U.S. driver's license, employer ID, school ID, U.S. state ID, military ID, national ID, visa, passport. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Social Security cards for you, your spouse and dependents
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: ITIN letters for anyone on the return who does not have a Social Security number
items.detail: For you, your spouse and your dependents. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Proof of foreign status
items.detail: Only if applying for an ITIN. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Birth dates for you, your spouse and dependents on the tax return
Form W-2 wage and earning statements from all employers
Form 1099-R for retirement account, pension or annuity payments
Social Security Benefit Statement (Form SSA-1099)
Form RRB-1099 for Railroad Retirement benefits
Form 1099-G for unemployment benefits
Interest and dividend statements from banks (Forms 1099)
Form W-2G for gambling winnings
Form 1099-MISC
Copies of income transcripts from the IRS and state, if applicable
A copy of last year's federal and state returns, if available
Proof of bank account routing and account numbers for direct deposit, such as a blank check
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Estimated tax payments made, and any refund from last year applied to this year's tax
Total paid to the daycare provider and the provider's tax identifying number
items.detail: The provider's SSN or business EIN. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Form 1095-A, Health Insurance Marketplace Statement
Health Insurance Exemption Certificate, if received
Form 1098-E for student loan interest
Form 1098-T from the school
items.detail: The intake sheet also mentions an itemized statement from the school or an invoice.
